reviews.text: Ive just recently finished my 30 day grooming training with Michaela and Cathy at Canine Creations. Its honestly been the best experience of my life! The exceptional knowledge from the girls is second to none,there is no question that they cant answer. There is so much to learn in dog grooming, but you can be assured that by the time your training is complete, you will have all the information, hands on training and tips of dog grooming. As a student, you work on so many different dog breeds, some I have never even heard of before! From your very first day, everyone is so welcoming, the environment has such a calm feel to it. You will receive so much support, endless encouragement, and training from two of the most exceptionally talented girls in the grooming world. I have wanted to do dog grooming for a very long time, I done my research and there was no doubt in my mind I was going to Canine Creations. If your thinking of dog grooming, Canine Creations is the place to go. 🐾 I am so excited for whats to come, I feel confident taking the next step in dog grooming, but I have all the skills I need thanks to Michaela and Cathy. I will remember my time at Canine Creations forever with the best memories. Thanks for everything 🐾✨️

Cathy and Michaela made the course very enjoyable and are brilliant teachers. They recognised my weaknesses and helped my confidence grow as the course went on. It was a very comfortable learning atmosphere and I enjoyed every day of the course. I would recommend this course for current groomers to up skill.

I’m so grateful to Cathy and Michaela for all their support throughout the course. I really enjoyed my time at Canine Creations and have gained so much confidence in my grooming skills. They were always so helpful and supportive, and I’ve learned so much throughout the course. Thank you both so much for everything! 🥰 …
An amazing place to do dog grooming training, Cathy and Michaela are so hands on and helpful every step of the way, I couldn’t recommend them enough! ☺️

I highly recommend the OCN NI Level 3 Diploma in Commercial Dog Grooming, Animal Welfare & Salon Management at Canine Creations to anyone considering a dog grooming course or a career change. The course is very hands-on and you work on a variety of breeds. The salon environment is so welcoming and pleasant, and both Cathy and Michaela are phenomenal teachers.
I genuinely didn’t want the course to end! I’ve really enjoyed every minute of it and have gained so much confidence, knowledge and practical experience along the way. I couldn’t recommend Canine Creations enough!

I've just finished their dog grooming course and it was exactly what I was looking for, hands on experience with amazingly talented tutors, Cathy and Michaela are so good at what they do! Would recommend it to everyone, such a lovely environment to practice in, loved it!

We couldn’t be happier with Zoey’s first hand stripping! The difference in her coat is incredible - she looks amazing, her coat is healthier than ever and she’s so much more comfy in the warm weather.

We barely had to explain the look we were after because Cathy immediately understood Zoey’s breed (Dachshund), wire-haired coat and what would suit her best - that gave us so much confidence that Zoey was in the best hands 🥰

We’re very happy we found Canine Creations, and Zoey def has her groomer for life now 💖

Highly recommend!

I can't recommend this course highly enough! Michaela and Cathy are absolutely amazing teachers. Their knowledge, patience, and encouragement made learning the skills to become a professional dog groomer such an enjoyable and rewarding experience.
They don't just teach grooming techniques they cover everything you need to know to succeed in the industry, from handling dogs with confidence to understanding the day-to-day realities of running a grooming business. Their support and guidance have given me the confidence to take the next step and open my own dog grooming salon.
Thank you, Michaela and Cathy for believing in me and for sharing your expertise. I genuinely couldn't have asked for better mentors

I recently completed the fast track option to obtain the level 3 ipet diploma. Having been in the industry for a couple of years I wanted to have a recognised qualification and improve my scissor skills.  I completed 5 days training and got to work on some breeds that I don't normally see in my own salon and learned how to handstrip. I would highly recommend the fast track course to anyone in the industry that would like to have a recognised qualification and to touch up on their skills. I got plenty of support on completing the assignments and diaries too. Thank you Cathy and Michaela ✨🐾

I thoroughly enjoyed my time at Canine Creations and would highly recommend it to anyone interested in dog grooming. The knowledge and experience I gained were invaluable, not only in developing practical grooming skills but also in learning about the day-to-day management and operation of a successful business.
The training was comprehensive, professional, and hands-on, allowing me to build confidence while working with a variety of dogs.
The atmosphere was positive and welcoming, with genuine respect shown to everyone—students, clients, and, most importantly, the dogs in their care.
Cathy and Mikaela were always so supportive and encouraging, and I am grateful for everything I learned during my time with them, thank you so much x

I recently completed the OCNI Level 3 Diploma in Commercial Dog Grooming, Animal Welfare and Salon Management course with Canine Creations in Sandyford and absolutely loved every minute of it.
The 30-day hands-on course gave fantastic practical experience with such a wide variety of dog breeds, all with their own personalities and grooming requirements. The practical learning was brilliant and really helped build my confidence and skills.
Michaela is an amazing trainer — patient, encouraging, incredibly knowledgeable and always calm and supportive. She is a born teacher who gives immediate constructive feedback and genuinely wants her students to succeed. Coming from a corporate career of over 25 years and making such a significant career change, her guidance and encouragement made all the difference.
Cathy and the team have created the most supportive and friendly environment I’ve ever worked in. I genuinely looked forward to going in every day. The flexible scheduling was a huge benefit, allowing me to complete the course part-time on days that suited me.
One thing future students should know is that while lots of excellent resources are provided, there are also multiple assignments that need to be submitted on certain days — so give yourself plenty of time and be prepared to put the work in. The support is there, but you need to do your part too.
I would recommend Canine Creations to anyone wanting to become a dog groomer, whether you hope to work in an established grooming salon or set up your own business from home. After this major career change, I have zero regrets.

The 30 Day Grooming Course was the best decision Ive made, Cathy and Michaela are very talented and professional in their craft and create such a supportive environment to learn in. Delighted that I did it and would highly recommend!

I recently completed the 30 day Level 3 Diploma in Commercial Dog Grooming, Animal Welfare and Salon Management with Canine Creations and I honestly can’t recommend it enough.

It’s such a lovely, positive learning environment. No question was ever too silly and that made a huge difference for me starting out. I started the course with no salon experience, coming from a totally different work background, which was daunting, but I was put at ease immediately by Cathy and Michaela.

They were also so accommodating. I was able to do the course while working full time, which I really appreciated.

Not only did I learn grooming, I also learned loads about animal health, canine first aid and salon management. I even got to practice putting together policies for my own future business, which was actually really helpful.

It was also really inspiring to learn from such highly experienced master and senior groomers, who were regularly attending further learning events and competitions themselves during my time there. It was really nice to see and made me want to keep improving too.

A lot of the days you’re going in and meeting new like-minded student groomers, who were really passionate about dog grooming and this makes the day really enjoyable.

I got so much support and guidance the whole way through and I really appreciated this in times when working with dogs that had some behavioural challenges. That support meant a lot.

Overall I’m just really grateful for the experience, everything I learned and I know that I’m going away with the continued support of Canine Creations starting out in the industry.
Thank you ❤️
